name: breakoutscanner-mcp
description: Public TypeScript SDK and CLI packages for the Breakout Scanner MCP workspace.

scripts.build: npm run build --workspace @breakoutscanner/mcp-sdk && npm run build --workspace @breakoutscanner/mcp-cli
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --workspace @breakoutscanner/mcp-sdk && npm run build --workspace @breakoutscanner/mcp-sdk && npm run typecheck --workspace @breakoutscanner/mcp-cli
scripts.test: npm run build --workspace @breakoutscanner/mcp-sdk && npm test --workspace @breakoutscanner/mcp-sdk && npm test --workspace @breakoutscanner/mcp-cli
scripts.verify: npm run verify:metadata && npm run build && npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run verify:pack
